coverageRationale.zh: 把“给不同人不同版本”的泄密调查做法写成可复述的组合归因模型：变体空间、指纹向量、候选集、碰撞界与标记存活率。明确它是归因工具，不是加密算法或动机证明。
coverageRationale.en: Formalizes the leak-investigation practice of giving different people different versions as a combinatorial attribution model: variant space, fingerprint vector, candidate set, collision bound and mark survival. It is an attribution tool, not a cipher or proof of intent.

entries.relatedPolicy: Related entries are distinct concepts; no merge or replacement is implied.

zh: 副本指纹：某一份文件在若干标记位置上的变体组合。
候选集 C(Q)：与泄露片段在位置集合 Q 上完全一致的副本集合。
标记存活率 p：标记经过改写、转述或重排后仍可辨认的概率。
碰撞界：n 个副本在 N 个可能指纹中发生重复的概率上界。
en: Copy fingerprint: the combination of variants at marked positions in one copy.
Candidate set C(Q): copies matching the leaked excerpt on position set Q.
Mark survival p: probability a mark remains recognizable after editing or retelling.
Collision bound: upper bound on duplicates among n copies in N possible fingerprints.

zh.principle: **攻击**：金丝雀陷阱（Canary Trap）。金丝雀陷阱的核心不是加密，而是分发侧的指纹化：同一份敏感文本准备多个语义等价、措辞或细节略有差异的版本，给每个可能接触者不同组合，并把“版本—持有人”映射秘密保存。泄露文本回流后，只比较被引用的少量片段，就能把候选范围从“所有持有人”缩到具体副本。形式化：设 m 个可替换位置，第 j 位有 v_j 个变体；总变体空间 N=∏v_j。副本 i 的指纹是 F_i=(f_i1,…,f_im)。泄露片段覆盖位置集合 Q，候选集 C(Q)={i | F_i[Q]=F_leak[Q]}；当 |C(Q)|=1 时完成归因。若各位置等概率分配，n 个副本发生碰撞的概率可用生日界 P_collision≤n(n-1)/(2N) 估算。实际泄露者会改写、摘录或转述。设每个标记位置在改写后仍可辨认的概率为 p，则可见位置数 K~Binomial(m,p)；要唯一归因，至少需要 q_min≈ceil(log n/log v) 个独立位置，成功率 P_unique=P(K≥q_min)。这就是“标记要多、但要自然”的量化理由。
zh.why: 传统访问控制只能降低泄露概率，不能回答“是谁”。金丝雀陷阱把调查从开放集变成有限候选集，且不依赖抓现行；它提供的是归因证据，不是预防。对泄密调查、董事会文件、并购材料和记者线人等场景，价值在于把“所有人都可能”变成“这份副本只给过谁”。但它不是密码学证明：如果副本被复印、转发、多人共读，指纹仍指向原始副本持有人，而不是实际转发者。它只能证明副本路径，不能证明主观恶意。
zh.used: 操作步骤：1）划定可能接触者与副本数量 n；2）选 m 个不影响语义的槽位（日期、代号、金额尾数、无关形容词）；3）给每副本分配唯一指纹，记录映射；4）让版本看起来同等可信；5）泄露发生后收集引用片段，按 Q 比对候选集；6）若候选不唯一，追加槽位或缩小分发范围。数字版本可用文档水印、不可见字符、不同链接/收件人、蜜标文件。关键是标记要能被引用者原样带走，且不改变业务含义。
zh.broken: 失效条件：改写或转述抹掉标记；副本被拍照、OCR、重新排版；多人共享同一副本；n 大于 N 导致碰撞；标记太显眼被识别后清除；法律或伦理上不得设置误导性内容或诱导犯罪。金丝雀陷阱也不能证明谁最终对外发布。
zh.history:
该技术情报界长期使用，有时称 barium meal test；Tom Clancy 1987 年小说让 canary trap 一词流行，书中描述每段摘要六个版本、96 份副本、超过一千种排列。数字时代出现文档指纹、水印和蜜标；2020 年代研究用生物特征与局部敏感哈希把文档与最后接触者关联，在删除 100 词等修改下平均成功率 89.31%，说明“文档本身作为证据”的思路仍在演进。

en.principle: **Attack**: Canary Trap (金丝雀陷阱). A canary trap is not about encryption; it is about distribution-side fingerprinting. The same sensitive text is prepared in several semantically equivalent versions with small differences in wording or details. Each possible recipient gets a different combination, and the version-to-holder map is kept secret. When a leaked text returns, a few quoted fragments can shrink the candidate set from “every holder” to a specific copy. Formally, let m positions be replaceable, with v_j variants at position j. The total variant space is N=∏v_j. Copy i has fingerprint F_i=(f_i1,…,f_im). A leaked excerpt covers position set Q, and the candidate set is C(Q)={i | F_i[Q]=F_leak[Q]}. Attribution is complete when |C(Q)|=1. If variants are assigned uniformly, the birthday bound P_collision≤n(n-1)/(2N) estimates the chance of a collision among n copies. Real leakers edit, excerpt or retell. If each marked position survives with probability p, the number of visible positions is K~Binomial(m,p). Unique attribution needs at least q_min≈ceil(log n/log v) independent positions, with success P_unique=P(K≥q_min). This is the quantitative reason marks should be numerous but natural.
en.why:
Access control lowers the probability of a leak but cannot answer “who”. A canary trap turns an open set into a finite candidate set and does not depend on catching someone in the act. It supplies attribution evidence, not prevention. In leak investigations, board documents, M&A materials and reporter relationships, its value is turning “anyone could have” into “this copy went only to these people”.

It is not a cryptographic proof. If a copy is photocopied, forwarded or read by several people, the fingerprint still points to the original copy holder, not necessarily the final publisher. It proves a copy path, not intent.
en.used:
Operational steps: 1) define the possible recipients and copy count n; 2) choose m slots that do not change meaning (dates, code names, last digits, harmless adjectives); 3) assign a unique fingerprint to each copy and record the map; 4) make every version look equally credible; 5) after a leak, collect the quoted fragments and compare them against C(Q); 6) if the candidate set is not unique, add slots or reduce distribution.

Digital versions can use document watermarks, invisible characters, recipient-specific links, or honeytoken files. The key is that a mark can be carried verbatim by the leaker without changing the business meaning.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken: Failure conditions: rewriting or retelling erases marks; copies are photographed, OCRed or retypeset; several people share one copy; n exceeds N and collisions appear; marks are so obvious that they are detected and removed; legal or ethical limits forbid misleading content or inducement. A canary trap also cannot prove who published the material.
en.history: Intelligence services used the technique long before the name; it is sometimes called a barium meal test. Tom Clancy's 1987 novel popularized “canary trap”, describing six versions of each summary paragraph, 96 copies and more than a thousand permutations. The digital age added document fingerprinting, watermarks and honeytokens. In the 2020s, a study combined biometrics and locality-sensitive hashing to link a document to its last handler, reporting an average 89.31% success rate even after modifications such as deleting 100 words. The idea of “the document itself as evidence” keeps evolving.
